rooms.name: stonework chamber
rooms.description: You are standing in a stonework chamber, fitted with dull grey stone tiles. The room is rectangular in shape and is roughly thirty feet by fifty feet across. The only visible exit is east through a stone archway. There is a stone staircase here leading upward.

rooms.name: stonework corridor
rooms.description: You are standing in a well kept stonework corridor. The tightly fit stone tiles that make up the floor and walls here bear unusal designs and are of very fine craftsmanship. A small lever is partially concealed in a niche in the east wall. The corridor runs to the north and south.

devices.note: Shrine Stoneworks 6 [L7]: "Pull Lever to open East Chasm (EC)". Seals stonework-corridor-202 w, whose description reads "A very wide natural chasm blocks the passage to the west." Shut, moving w answers "The wide chasm prevents your exit in that direction." while ex still lists w. The lever is in the description -- "A small lever is partially concealed in a niche in the east wall." Named by the user 2026-09-27. Toggles, per the user (2026-09-27): pulling it again closes the chasm, so only the first character through should pull it. The same is true of this level's other chasm lever, [L6]. Pulled 2026-09-27: the chasm opened and 202 w led to stonework-corridor-225, whose e is the far side of the same chasm and carries the same Seal (that it blocks from the west too is assumed, not tested). The description carries the Seal state: open, 202 reads just "The corridor runs to the east and west." -- the chasm sentence is gone -- which is what the stored description now says.
